da-false-claim.notes: Claim (1) monotonicity is correctly framed as SDP-relaxation monotonicity with the explicit caveat (md:122-127) that it is NOT Cauchy interlacing; the headline avoids asserting the noble-gas identification as proved. No outright false statement survives.

da-vacuous.notes: Substantive proof sketch with three distinct claims; not tautological.

da-circular.notes: The block explicitly declines the convenient circular move: it states the noble-gas closures are NOT reproduced by the bare categorical sigma_F (md:51-61) rather than back-fitting them. Honest non-circular framing.

da-overclaim.notes: Claim (3) 'Terminality' asserts noble-gas P^(Z) is a local terminal object because breaking μ≥2 tight blocks costs more than α·m_e·c_q^2 (md:152-159). This energetic-barrier inequality is the load-bearing step and is neither proved nor formalised — the Lean 'shell_closure_terminality' instead proves frobeniusStability D' q ≥ frobeniusStability D q (the upgrade is MORE stable, claim 1 direction) plus μ≥2, which is not terminality. The narrative presents terminality (and the chemical-inertness corollary) more strongly than either the sketch or Lean supports.

da-hidden-dof.notes: No undisclosed calibration; α, m_e, c_q^2 are canonical-chain quantities and the un-derived Madelung/2n^2 structure is openly flagged, not smuggled.

da-non-sequitur.notes: Claim (3): 'The energetic cost of breaking μ≥2 tight blocks is at least μ·ΔE_shell(q)' and then 'for q in the generic locus μ·ΔE_shell(q) > α·m_e·c_q^2, so no EM-mediated dressing can clear the barrier' — the strict inequality between the (un-quantified, 'derived categorically') shell-boundary gap and the EM binding scale is asserted with no supporting lemma, witness, or numeric bound. The 'therefore terminal' conclusion does not follow from any established step; it is the crux and is simply posited.

da-lean-narrative-divergence.notes: The headline Lean theorem ShellClosureStability concludes only `bindingMultiplicity D.shell q ≥ 2`, supplied by the `NobleGasMultiOperator` class hypothesis and discharged by projection (shell_closure_noble_multiplicity := noble_gas_multi_operator) — it proves the multiplicity is ≥2 by assuming an instance asserting it. The .md headline ('noble-gas configurations are local terminal objects') and claims (2) local-maximum-of-Δσ_F and (3) terminality/energetic-barrier are NOT what Lean proves. shell_closure_terminality proves σ_F monotone-up + μ≥2, i.e. strictly weaker/different than the .md terminality claim. Lean ⊊ narrative.

da-citation-misuse.notes: Boyd–Vandenberghe §5.4.1/§5.6 is correctly invoked for SDP-relaxation / value-function sensitivity monotonicity; appropriate attribution.

da-definitional-ambiguity.notes: ΔE_shell(q) ('the single-block shell-boundary gap, derived categorically') and the 'generic locus' of q are used quantitatively in the decisive inequality but never defined or bounded; 'binding multiplicity μ(S_Z,q)≥2' depends on a binding-multiplicity definition not given in-block. The decisive comparison rests on undefined magnitudes.

da-empirical-fragility.notes: No numerical match to experiment is claimed; the block explicitly says σ_F does NOT reproduce the noble-gas peaks. No fitted number to be fragile.

da-physical-implausibility.notes: Equating electron magic numbers {2,10,18,36,54,86} with nucleon magic numbers {2,8,20,28,50,82,126} as 'the same structural phenomenon' (interprets.md:60-70) papers over that the two sequences arise from genuinely different (Coulomb vs nuclear spin-orbit) physics; the corollary deriving XeF4 from 'q far from generic locus' is a qualitative gesture, not a checkable physical claim. Conditional framing softens this to warn.

da-referee-verdict.notes: verdict: major-revision. referee_argument: The proposition is commendably honest about the un-derived Madelung/2n^2 structure and correctly distinguishes SDP-relaxation monotonicity from interlacing, but its two headline payloads — claim (2) local-maximum-at-closure and claim (3) terminality — are not established. The decisive terminality inequality μ·ΔE_shell(q) > α·m_e·c_q^2 (md:156-158) is asserted with no bound on either side, and the Lean formalisation proves only `bindingMultiplicity ≥ 2` (by projecting an assumed NobleGasMultiOperator instance) plus σ_F-monotonicity — strictly weaker than, and in claim-3's case orthogonal to, the narrative terminality claim. The .md title 'local terminal objects' therefore overstates what is proved. Restate claim (3) as conditional/open and align the Lean target with the narrative or vice versa.
